========================================
Bare generator macro inside a switch body
========================================

int f(int t) {
  switch (t) {
#define TD(E, T, C) case BASE_##E: return sizeof(C);
    GEN_TYPES(TD)
#undef TD
    default: ASSERT(0);
  }
}

---

(translation_unit
    (function_definition
        (primitive_type)
        (function_declarator
            (identifier)
            (parameter_list
                (parameter_declaration
                    (primitive_type)
                    (identifier))))
        (compound_statement
            (switch_statement
                (condition_clause
                    (identifier))
                (compound_statement
                    (preproc_function_def
                        (identifier)
                        (preproc_params
                            (identifier)
                            (identifier)
                            (identifier))
                        (preproc_arg))
                    (macro_declaration
                        (identifier)
                        (macro_argument_list
                            (identifier)))
                    (preproc_call
                        (preproc_directive)
                        (preproc_arg))
                    (case_statement
                        (macro_declaration
                            (identifier)
                            (macro_argument_list
                                (number_literal)))
                        (expression_statement)))))))
